intro.title: Photo Capture & Upload
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a mobile app that can take photos using the device's camera and upload them to a server. You will learn how to use the Capacitor Camera API to capture images and the Capacitor Filesystem API to read the photo data. The core programming concept involves using Promises to handle asynchronous operations like camera access and file reading. You will implement this in an Ionic Angular app, creating a service to manage the photo logic and a component with a button to trigger the capture and upload process.
intro.usecase: Photo capture and upload functionality is essential in mobile apps that require user-generated content, such as social media platforms like Instagram or Facebook where users post photos. In e-commerce apps like eBay or Facebook Marketplace, sellers use this feature to upload product images directly from their device camera. Customer service applications often allow users to attach photos of issues or documents for verification purposes. Healthcare apps might use photo capture for telemedicine consultations where patients share symptoms visually. Even note-taking apps like Evernote use this pattern to let users add photos to their notes for richer documentation.
